Package model

Class Habitat

java.lang.Object
model.Habitat
public class Habitat extends Object
Description: Represents a physical habitat in the zoo, managing housed animals and assigned employees.

  • Constructor Details

    • Habitat

      public Habitat(String HabitatId, String name, EnvironmentType environment, double temperature, double area, int maxCapacity, double budget, String state)
      Description: Constructs a new Habitat object with its attributes and initializes the internal animal and employee lists.
      Parameters:
      HabitatId - Unique identifier for the habitat.
      name - Name of the habitat.
      environment - EnvironmentType enum specifying the habitat's environment.
      temperature - Temperature value of the habitat.
      area - Area size of the habitat.
      maxCapacity - Maximum capacity of animals allowed.
      budget - Budget allocated for the habitat.
      state - Operational state of the habitat. Precondition: Parameters must be valid and non-null for reference types. Postcondition: A new Habitat instance is created with initialized collections.

    • addAnimal

      public boolean addAnimal(Animal myAnimal)
      Description: Adds an animal to the habitat if capacity allows, it is not already contained, and environments match.
      Parameters:
      myAnimal - Animal object to add.
      Returns:
      True if the animal is successfully added, false otherwise. Precondition: myAnimals list must be initialized. Postcondition: The animal is added to the habitat's animal collection if rules pass.

    • assingEmployee

      public boolean assingEmployee(Employee myEmployee)
      Description: Assigns an employee to the habitat, validating medical environment restrictions.
      Parameters:
      myEmployee - Employee object to assign.
      Returns:
      True if the employee is successfully assigned, false otherwise. Precondition: assignEmployees list must be initialized. Postcondition: The employee is added to the habitat's employee list if role and environment constraints are satisfied.
